description: Records what the user says ACTUALLY happened in a gym session (reps, weights, RPE, notes), because the watch only records the guide's planned text. Writes only ~/.suunto-mcp/journal.json (SUUNTO_JOURNAL_PATH overrides it); never contacts Suunto. One entry per workoutKey: logging it again REPLACES the entry (the old one is returned as `replaced`). A call with no note, feeling, tags or exercises is refused (nothing to log). Unknown fields (e.g. `weight`) are refused (unknown field error naming it); use `kg` in a set. A call with ONLY tags keeps the entry's other fields. Only record what the user told you. Limits: reps 0-200, kg 0-1000, rpe 1-10, texts 500 characters, 40 exercises with 20 sets each, 8 tags of 1-24 characters (trimmed, no control characters, no case-insensitive duplicates). source 'draft' marks an entry made from a confirmed draft_session_log.

exercises.description: What was actually done per exercise; leave out exercises that went as planned.

note.description: How the session went, in the user's words.

source.description: 'draft' when the exercises come from a confirmed draft_session_log.

tags.description: Optional labels, e.g. ['deload', 'poor-sleep']. Sent alone, they set the tags and leave the rest.

workoutKey.description: 24-hex id of the session, from list_workouts.

name: log_session
title: Log what actually happened in a session
